name: Cyclomatic Complexity (Max)
description: Maximum decision paths in any single function. Reduced by extracting pipeline steps.

name: Cognitive Complexity
description: Measure of mental effort required to understand control flow and nesting depth.

name: Maintainability Index (MI)
description: Halstead volume, cyclomatic complexity, and line count composite (higher is better).

name: Maximum Nesting Depth
description: Maximum indentation level of conditional and looping constructs.

name: Batch Processing Time (1,000 Orders)
description: Time required to validate, price, reserve, and charge 1,000 multi-item orders.

name: Peak Memory Footprint (Under Load)
description: Heap allocation during batch execution, stabilized by eliminating unbounded caches.

name: Automated Test Coverage
description: Unit and edge-case branch coverage enabled by modular dependency injection.
